_comment: Right-click help for the Ship Designer, transcribed from _static_design_screen_help_list (evanhelp.cpp:22-36, {help_id, x1, y1, x2, y2}), installed by Set_Design_Screen_Help_List_ (evanhelp.cpp:314-334), which moves the weapon table's region (383) and the specials table's (385) down below the loaded rows: y1 + n*14 + 15, capped at y2 ('rows' names which count). First hit wins, the list's own order.
hd_extension: The help popup auto-sizes to its text and scrolls when it cannot fit. The original draws a fixed box and lets FMTPARA wrap into it at a fixed 339 px (TEXTBOX::Draw_Help_Entry_, textbox.cpp:307); at four HD resolutions a fixed box either wastes half the screen on two lines or clips a long entry. Marked once per file, here, and in core/helppopup.py.
